title: Getting started with blink
text: Build unmodified malariasimulation parameter list run . supply target adult EIR (infectious bites per adult per year); model seeds corresponding equilibrium, separate burn-needed aseasonal run. return value wide, malariasimulation-style daily count table. Column tags carry age band days: 730_3650 canonical 2-10y band (always included), 0_36500 ages. p_detect_lm_* LM-detectable prevalence, EIR per adult per year, ft treated fraction. model mean-field, prevalence EIR population-independent; human_population rescales count columns. interventions model holds flat seeded equilibrium, first last rows agree:
code: p <- malariasimulation::get_parameters(list(human_population = 1000))  # 15 years at a daily step, seeded at the equilibrium for EIR = 20 out <- run_simulation_ode(timesteps = 15 * 365, parameters = p, init_EIR = 20)  out[1:3, c("timestep", "n_age_730_3650", "n_detect_lm_730_3650",            "p_detect_lm_730_3650", "EIR", "ft")] #>   timestep n_age_730_3650 n_detect_lm_730_3650 p_detect_lm_730_3650 EIR ft #> 1        0       284.2213             155.5888            0.5474214  20  0 #> 2        1       284.2213             155.5888            0.5474214  20  0 #> 3        2       284.2213             155.5888            0.5474214  20  0 range(out$EIR)                    # ~20 throughout #> [1] 20 20 range(out$p_detect_lm_730_3650)   # constant to machine precision #> [1] 0.5474214 0.5474214

title: Getting started with blink
text: PEV reduces infection hazard per-age, per-time factor built profile’s point-estimate antibody -> efficacy curve; primary booster doses, EPI mass campaigns, time-varying EPI coverage modelled. Transmission-blocking vaccines available via set_tbv().
code: p_pev <- malariasimulation::set_pev_epi(   malariasimulation::get_parameters(list(human_population = 1000)),   profile = malariasimulation::rtss_profile,   timesteps = 1, coverages = 0.9, min_wait = 0, age = round(6 * 30),   booster_spacing = round(12 * 30), booster_coverage = matrix(0.8, 1, 1),   booster_profile = list(malariasimulation::rtss_booster_profile))  pev <- run_simulation_ode(12 * 365, p_pev, init_EIR = 20) c(baseline = pev$p_detect_lm_730_3650[1],   year12   = pev$p_detect_lm_730_3650[nrow(pev)]) #>  baseline    year12  #> 0.5474214 0.5122024

title: Getting started with blink
text: blink checked two ways. First, self-consistency: interventions holds flat malariaEquilibrium seed machine precision (still holds flat treatment, ft > 0, thanks corrected prophylaxis-aging recursion). Second, agreement IBM: parameter list passed models — malariasimulation burned 30 years population 10,000, model seeded equilibrium — across six scenarios (comparison/). Representative agreement: Equilibrium PfPR(2-10) vs EIR tracks IBM closely (e.g. EIR 20: IBM 0.553 vs ODE 0.547; EIR 120: 0.788 vs 0.786). age-prevalence profile EIR 20 agrees max |IBM - ODE| = 0.008 (mean 0.004) across bands infancy 85y. Custom demography reproduces IBM’s -5 population fraction (IBM 0.090 vs ODE 0.088). Bed nets, seasonality SMC scenarios compared well (including clinical severe incidence time series); see comparison/plots/ figures. LM prevalence clinical incidence match IBM within ~1%. Severe incidence (DALYs derived ) sensitive immunity model can differ ~5-20% (largest low EIR); treat indicative.

title: Getting started with blink
text: P. falciparum . P. vivax rejected; model always compartmental (individual-mosquito code path apply). Mean-field caveats. Vector control population-averaged (slightly -suppresses deep troughs vs IBM); drug prophylaxis slow parasite clearance single mean-duration compartments (equilibrium-exact, transient-approximate); vaccine efficacy uses profile point estimates (per-person antibody variation). PCR prevalence follows IBM convention (D/Tr//U). documented README’s Mean-field approximations section.

title: blink • a fast ODE twin of malariasimulation
text: blink reproduces Griffin-style, age- biting-heterogeneity-structured human model — states S / D / / U / Tr plus two prophylaxis compartments (Ph, treatment-linked, Ph_c, chemoprevention) six immunity functions IB / ICA / ICM / ID / IVA / IVM — coupled compartmental mosquito model (E / L / P / Sm / EIP-chain / Im per species). written odin2 / dust2. exists give malariasimulation ecosystem deterministic, Monte-Carlo-free companion : Takes inputs IBM. run_simulation_ode() accepts malariasimulation::get_parameters() list (usual set_* intervention builders layered ) unchanged. P. falciparum . seeded , validated , equilibrium. Initial conditions come malariaEquilibrium; interventions model holds flat equilibrium machine precision, reproduces IBM’s equilibrium PfPR within IBM’s Monte-Carlo error. Produces postie-compatible outputs. returned wide count table feeds straight postie::get_rates() / postie::get_prevalence(); get_epi_outputs() returns list. fast population-independent. human/mosquito compartments per-capita densities, 20-year daily run takes order couple seconds regardless modelled population size. Reach IBM instead need stochastic variation, individual heterogeneity beyond mean field, P. vivax.

title: blink • a fast ODE twin of malariasimulation
text: model honest much departs IBM. Every item exact equilibrium; caveats concern transient dynamics diagnostic conventions. Numerics & lags. human EIR/FOIM lags mosquito EIP implemented Erlang (linear-chain) filters rather delay() — robust, pure-ODE, exact equilibrium. Stage counts (n_eir, n_foim, n_eip; defaults 10 / 10 / 20) tunable: larger values sharpen gamma-shaped lags toward IBM’s fixed delays. disease-state seed re-solves prophylaxis aging recursion corrected bP term (upstream malariaEquilibrium::human_equilibrium_no_het small artifact), model holds flat even treatment (ft > 0). Treatment & resistance. Drug prophylaxis single mean-duration compartment (Weibull represented mean, decay exponential rather sharper Weibull), slow parasite clearance blended treated-recovery rate (two sub-compartments); equilibrium-exact, transient-approximate. Antimalarial resistance (early-treatment-failure slow-parasite-clearance) blended across treatment drugs share treatment also applies drug used chemoprevention (SMC/MDA/PMC). multi-drug blend uses fixed peak-coverage weights, first-line switch (several clinical drugs whose relative shares change time) approximated constant drug mixture — warned, exact single drug constant shares. Vector control. Net/IRS efficacy population-averaged net-using / sprayed fractions per-species (t), mu(t). exponential (log-uniform) logistic net retention supported, repeated distributions accumulate full mean-field mixture past rounds (weighted -recent-receipt probability, net-age efficacy decay); IRS accumulates way without retention factor (sprayed protection never expires IBM). coverage population-averaged rather per-individual, nets/IRS ODE tends -suppress transmission relative IBM intervention era (correlated protection individuals across bites mean-field gap; larger ≤ ~5% single-round equilibrium bias). Chemoprevention. MDA/SMC/PMC applied pulses ODE segments: fraction (coverage × drug efficacy × (1 − resistance ETF)) target age band cleared moved chemoprevention prophylaxis compartment Ph_c. target band mapped onto model age groups fractional overlap, narrow bands (e.g. PMC dose ages) captured rather dropped coarse groups -treated. Co-deployed chemoprevention types share coverage-weighted Ph_c decay. PMC (age-triggered IBM) approximated ~monthly pulses dose-age band; pulses take effect day scheduled timestep. Vaccines. PEV reduces infection hazard per-age, per-time factor built profile’s point-estimate (median) antibody trajectory → Hill efficacy curve (create_pev_profile(), including RTS,S R21; individual antibody variation modelled — R21 can overstate efficacy ~5 pp). full booster sequence modelled — vaccinated partitioned recent booster reached, stratum carrying decayed efficacy — EPI mass campaigns. EPI uses time-varying coverage (cohort protected coverage force vaccination date); mass campaigns apply every target age band every campaign, decaying efficacy (vaccinated cohort age band). Seasonal PEV boosters approximated fixed days-since-primary schedule (warned). TBV reduces onward infectivity via state-specific transmission-blocking-activity transform exact target ages, matching IBM. Seasonality. Rainfall truncated Fourier series (matching IBM), driving K(t) = K0 · scaler(t) · rainfall(t) / R̄. seed annual-mean state, first ~10 years transient onto limit cycle seasonal annual-mean EIR sits percent aseasonal init_EIR target (nonlinear averaging) — burn calibrating. carrying-capacity scaler exactly 0 floored small residual (K0 · 1e-4), complete vector elimination reproduced exactly. Demography. Custom demography time-varying: mu_age(t) constant-interpolated series deathrate_timesteps (baseline row seeds equilibrium age structure, age-specific mortality evolves demographic transition). oldest model age group exceeds top deathrate_agegroups, ages take top death rate whereas IBM removes — raise default_age_lower(max_age =) extend deathrate_agegroups match (warning fires diverge). Diagnostic conventions. PCR prevalence counts D / Tr / / U (malariasimulation IBM convention), malariaEquilibrium’s sub-patent-weighted pos_PCR. LM prevalence clinical incidence match IBM ~1%. Severe incidence follows malariaEquilibrium convention far sensitive immunity model prevalence clinical incidence: steep severe Hill function amplifies small differences acquired immunity disease-pool composition mean field IBM, can differ ~5–20% (largest low EIR). (separate, smaller, opposite-signed effect: IBM adds +0.5 offset acquired immunity severe Hill function, ODE omits.) Treat severe incidence — DALYs derived — indicative. Reported EIR per adult per year (equals init_EIR equilibrium). Compare malariasimulation run EIR_<species> / human_population × 365.

text: fast, deterministic mean-field (ODE) counterpart malariasimulation individual-based model Plasmodium falciparum malaria, built odin2 / dust2 stack. reproduces age- biting-heterogeneity-structured human model (states S/D//U/Tr plus treatment chemoprevention prophylaxis, six immunity functions) coupled compartmental mosquito model, honours intervention modules. accepts unmodified malariasimulation::get_parameters() list, seeded malariaEquilibrium fixed point, returns malariasimulation-style outputs feed straight postie. multi-decade run completes seconds, independent population size.

title: Run the mean-field (ODE) malaria model. — run_simulation_ode
text: timesteps number days simulate. Output timesteps + 1 rows (day 0 seeded equilibrium; days 1..timesteps integrated). parameters malariasimulation::get_parameters() list (falciparum), optionally interventions layered via set_* builders. following applied automatically list (extra arguments): clinical treatment (time-varying), antimalarial resistance, bed nets, IRS, MDA/SMC/PMC, PEV (EPI + mass) TBV vaccines, seasonality flexible carrying capacity, custom demography (set_demography: age-specific mortality resulting equilibrium age structure). P. vivax rejected; model always compartmental (individual-mosquito path apply). See README mean-field approximations used module. correlations accepted first three arguments mirror malariasimulation::run_simulation(timesteps, parameters, correlations) exactly (drop-call compatibility). Intervention correlation individual-level feature mean-field analogue, non-NULL value ignored warning (ODE assumes independence interventions). init_EIR target adult EIR (bites/adult/year). NULL, taken parameters$init_EIR (set malariasimulation::set_equilibrium()). age_lower age-group lower edges years (default graded grid). n_eir, n_foim, n_eip Erlang-chain stage counts EIR lag, FOIM lag mosquito EIP. Larger values sharpen (otherwise gamma-shaped) lags toward IBM's fixed delays; equilibrium exact value. atol, rtol, step_size_max dust2 ODE-solver controls. defaults (1e-8, 1e-8, 1) preserve flat equilibrium exactly; long dynamic projections looser tolerance larger step cap (e.g. 1e-6, 1e-6, 10) run several times faster negligible effect aggregate outputs. odin_file optional path odin source (development use).

title: Run the mean-field (ODE) malaria model. — run_simulation_ode
text: wide, malariasimulation-style daily count table, one row per output day. Columns: timestep — output day (0..timesteps), row key. per age band (tags days, <lo>_<hi>): n_age_* (population), n_detect_lm_* p_detect_lm_* (LM-positive count PfPR proportion), n_detect_pcr_*, n_inc_clinical_*, n_inc_severe_* n_inc_* (-infection incidence) — per-day counts. ft (treated fraction), EIR (per adult per year), FOIM. population-total infection-state counts S_count, D_count, A_count, U_count, Tr_count, Ph_count (diagnostic). Incidence columns per-day counts; thin rows postie. Can passed directly postie::get_rates() / postie::get_prevalence().

title: Run the mean-field (ODE) malaria model. — run_simulation_ode
text: Seasonal runs oscillate around limit cycle rather holding flat; state seeded annual-mean (aseasonal) equilibrium, first ~10 years transient onto cycle seasonal annual-mean EIR sits percent aseasonal init_EIR target (nonlinear averaging). Use burned-cycle calibration/comparison.

title: blink 0.0.0.9000
text: Clinical treatment (time-varying coverage) antimalarial resistance (early-treatment-failure slow-parasite-clearance arms, coverage-weighted across drugs). Bed nets indoor residual spraying (mean-field vector control). Chemoprevention: MDA, SMC PMC, applied pulsed mass drug administration. Vaccines: pre-erythrocytic (RTS,S / R21; EPI mass, boosters time-varying EPI coverage) transmission-blocking (TBV). Seasonality (Fourier rainfall driving larval carrying capacity) flexible carrying capacity. Custom demography (set_demography): time-varying age-specific mortality (mu_age(t) interpolated deathrate_timesteps) resulting equilibrium age structure. Bed nets support exponential (log-uniform) logistic net retention, accumulate repeated distributions full mean-field usage mixture (-recent-receipt x retention survival, per-distribution net-age decay) — needed run real site::site_parameters() inputs. run_simulation_ode() exposes dust2 solver controls (atol, rtol, step_size_max) faster long dynamic projections.

title: blink 0.0.0.9000
text: systematic audit every user-facing malariasimulation config function (get_parameters + set_*) closed gaps model uses full parameter flexibility expose: PEV now models full booster sequence (just first booster), per-booster profiles, spacing, (conditional) coverage — set_pev_epi set_mass_pev; min_wait honoured. Mass PEV applies every target age band every campaign (multiple min_ages/max_ages longer collapsed campaign count). Chemoprevention (MDA/SMC/PMC) targets age bands fractional overlap model age groups, narrow bands (e.g. PMC dose ages) longer silently dropped coarse groups longer -treated. Co-deployed chemoprevention types share coverage-weighted prophylaxis duration. Antimalarial resistance (early-treatment-failure) now applies drug used chemoprevention (SMC/MDA/PMC), clinical treatment. IRS now accumulates across spray rounds (sprayed protection never expires IBM), matching bed-net accumulation. TBV targets exact ages set (non-contiguous ages honoured). set_equilibrium’s custom eq_params read explicitly. New -infection incidence output (n_inc_*; incidence_rendering_*). Remaining mean-field approximations (time-varying multi-drug first-line switch; seasonal PEV boosters) warned, silently applied.
